text: KEEP: Template intact, rs_rank_pct 85.1, W/D above EMA9, 9>21. I ratify the add as printed, close_above:bar_high on D on 1.4x volume within 5pct of the pivot. Professionals add only on strength, after the position shows a profit (C9); a reclaim of ma_20 adds into a dip. H1 sits below EMA9 with LH/LL, so the add waits for the hourly to re-align before that daily close counts; that is timing, not a new trigger. Nothing moves me to reclaim:ma_20. Wrong if a close under ma_50.
